set.typical_award_size: Gap loans from the City's inclusionary in-lieu fee fund (Fund 238) and commercial housing trust fund (Fund 221). FY 2025-26 Mid-Year Budget (March 10, 2026): Fund 238 cash $23,960,396 at July 1, 2025, projected $23,850,147 at June 30, 2026; Fund 221 cash $951,872, projected $858,319. FY 2024-25 AB 1600 report: Fund 238 available balance $24,487,971 after $29.7M in loans receivable; Fund 221 available $978,809. Draws since mid-2025: $615,000 from Fund 238 to the General Fund for the Habitat for Humanity 300 Persifer Street sale (Res. 11467, Oct 14, 2025) and a $1.55M Fund 238 appropriation to buy two vacant Historic District housing sites on Leidesdorff Street, APNs 070-0046-026 and 070-0042-002 (Res. 11659, CEQA exemption filed June 24, 2026). Since 2019 the Council approved $13.7M in long-term loans for over 550 units in six projects; the last loan commitment was Harrington Grove, $2.7M for 52 units (2024). Guidelines adopted by Res. 11427 on August 26, 2025.
set.next_deadline: No open round as of November 10, 2026. No AHL NOFA or new loan award found in Council records from mid-2026 through November 2026; the 2025 guidelines allow strategic NOFAs when resources are available. Contact Housing Services via the Community Development Department, (916) 461-6000.
set.cycle_notes: Rolling, developer-initiated requests under the AHL guidelines (Res. 11427); NOFAs contemplated but none issued as of November 10, 2026. In 2026 the City used Fund 238 for land acquisition (Res. 11659, $1.55M, Leidesdorff Street sites designated for housing at a minimum of 20 units per acre and listed for lower-income RHNA), consistent with Housing Element Program H-17, which the 2025 APR says the City would explore in 2026. The FY 2026-27 budget was adopted June 9, 2026, but its fund-level housing figures were not found (folsom.ca.us returns 403).

set.typical_award_size: Commercial linkage fee under FMC 3.90.010, indexed annually by the ENR Construction Cost Index: $2.08 per square foot through June 30, 2026 and $2.13 per square foot (office, retail, light and heavy industrial, manufacturing) from July 1, 2026 per Resolution 11601 (April 28, 2026 hearing, 2.43% adjustment). Deposited in the Housing Trust Fund (Fund 221) and used mainly to fill gaps in affordable rental projects through the AHL Program. FY 2024-25 AB 1600 report: fees collected $170,963, available fund balance $978,809 after $1.80M in loans receivable. FY 2025-26 Mid-Year Budget: cash $951,872 at July 1, 2025, projected $858,319 at June 30, 2026.
set.next_deadline: No open round as of November 10, 2026. Deployed through the AHL Program; no NOFA found. Fee paid at building permit.
set.cycle_notes: Fee rate adjusts each July 1 by the ENR CCI (Res. 7812, 2006). Fund 221 is deployed through the AHL Program (Res. 11427); no NOFA as of November 10, 2026.
set.layering_notes: Minor source compared with Fund 238. Folsom's rate ($2.13 from July 1, 2026) is below Sacramento County's $2.17 commercial and $3.26 office rates (effective March 28, 2025). Rate source is the Resolution 11601 fee schedule in the April 28, 2026 Council packet; adoption minutes were not opened. The AB 1600 report notes the fund holds fees beyond five years, reserved until enough accumulates for a project. Chapter 3.90 text itself was not opened (codepublishing.com and folsom.ca.us return 403).
set.audit_note: Sac suburbs follow-up Nov 10, 2026: fee corrected from $2.08 to $2.13 per sq ft effective July 1, 2026 (Res. 11601 packet); balance updated from the FY 2024-25 AB 1600 report and March 2026 mid-year budget. No NOFA found.

reason: Fee indexed to $2.13 per sq ft from July 1, 2026 and fund balance updated; no NOFA issued.
